cues.text: A forty-five-year-old man has gastro-oesophageal reflux disease.
He is due to have a laparoscopic Nissen fundoplication, an anti-reflux operation.
The top of the stomach is wrapped around the lower oesophagus.
The right and left vagus nerves form plexuses around the oesophagus.
So the vagus nerves are vulnerable during anti-reflux surgery.
In a Nissen fundoplication, the structures in danger are the vagus nerves.
